notes.title: Update #22: Eggstermination Eggstravaganza!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995291/1c6104c58d9593d5a8b1ac8d766fb3f58090ae21.png[/img]

The 22nd update for Swarmcade is now live! Highlights include a cracking new bonus character to unlock, a fresh bonus weapon, a egg-citing new secret boss, and an egg-stra special power-up. This update also brings a new achievement, some quality-of-life improvements, and the usual bug fixes.

[h1]Highlights[/h1]

[h2]New Bonus Hero: Eggslinger[/h2]

Celebrating Easter, the Eggslinger hero is armed with his unique special weapon, the Egg Launcher. It fires unpredictable homing eggs that scale in power and duration the higher your level. Not only that, but the Eggslinger hero will periodically drop the new egg power-up, giving him more regular access to the powerful egg effects. Unlock him by cracking the secret Eggfrafa boss wide open.

[h2]New Power-up: Eggstravaganza![/h2]

A new power-up has been added to the random drop pool. When an egg is obtained, players will have a choice of six egg-cellent effects to choose from – try them all out to see (the egg-themed names will crack the mystery)! Five of the effects are fixed and will be very useful, but one will offer more unpredictable results. Clever use of the egg will make cracking tougher achievements, like 20k kills, or reaching LV250, much easier.

[h2]V1.0.6  Patch notes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] NEW Bonus hero added - Eggslinger, periodically drops eggs
[*] NEW Bonus weapon added (exclusive to Eggslinger) - Egg Launcher, fires unpredictable homing eggs 
[*] NEW Secret boss added to all stages - Eggfrafa
[*] NEW Power-up added - Eggstravaganza!
[*] Balance - Nerfed Hearteater's black heart damage
[*] QoL - Added kill count to Run History, shortened Hero names

notes.title: Update #21: Love Hurts
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995291/37d6589615734a8ccc33de771588dba8254120f4.png[/img]

The 21st update for Swarmcade is now live! Highlights include a new bonus character to unlock, a new bonus weapon, a new boss, and the addition of Run History. This update also brings a new achievement, various quality-of-life improvements, balance changes, and bug fixes

[h2]New Hero: Matchmaker[/h2]

Celebrating Valentine's, the Matchmaker hero is ready to remind you that love hurts! Armed with his enchanted bow, HeartSploder, he fires explosive heart-shaped projectiles that detonate on impact, dealing area damage to foes while mending his own wounds with every successful strike. Unlock him by defeating the new boss.

[h2]New Feature: Run History[/h2]

This update adds a Run History, a new addition selectable from the main menu that records key details from your last 10 runs. Now, every attempt will be logged, showing which hero you played, the stage and difficulty you tackled, and whether you won or lost. You'll also be able to review your weapon and item loadout, along with the highest wave you reached, giving you valuable insight into what worked and what didn’t! Keep in mind, this is not retroactive, so only runs after this update will be recorded.

notes.title: Update #666, Chapter 2 - The Banishing
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995291/dc3d469e20b53af17d91febdc9823c715b0c3ed7.png[/img]

The nineteenth update for Swarmcade is now live, adding the much-requested Banish mechanic, two new Halloween themed characters to unlock, as well as a new secret boss and 2 new achievements. Alongside the usual Balance, QOL/tweaks, and some bug fixes from 1.0.

[h2]Highlights[/h2]

[h3]Banishing[/h3]

The biggest new addition is the game finally has the banish feature. If you're somehow not familiar with this mechanic from other games in the genre, it basically allows you to remove any item or weapon from the item pool during a run. This allows more manipulation of the RNG, hopefully allowing you to get the things you want.

In Swarmcade, this is how it works. First it must be unlocked in upgrades (this can be upgraded 5 times for a total of 5 banishments). Then a new NPC merchant will appear on any stage alongside the other merchant (if you have unlocked both). Unlike the item/weapon merchant he will not take a chunk of your precious life, his only currency is how many banishes you have. The weapons/items to choose from are randomised and you can use rerolls.

[h3]NEW Bonus Hero[/h3]

Two new Halloween themed heroes have been added to the bonus roster. [spoiler] Pumpkinhed[/spoiler] is unlockable through killing at least 666 pumpkins in a single run (you must have first unlocked the bonus character select). [spoiler]Boogeyman[/spoiler] is available through the lucky draw.

notes.title: Update #18: The Big One
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995291/4ca6060509d070786ddb06db0e15a2273dc4bf1b.png[/img]

The eighteenth update for Swarmcade is now live! After a bit longer than hoped (that's game dev for you), 1.0 is finally here! This is the biggest update to the game since the early access launch. A new stage, new difficulty, new upgrades, new heroes, enemies and bosses/elites. Plus some much-requested quality of life and features, new achievements and more.

There's a lot to go through so let's begin!

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

Note: Some text has been marked as spoilers as some of you may prefer to find out the major new features/rewards and unlocks through actual gameplay.

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]Title Screen added and Title Music
[*]Bonus Stage (unlocked after surviving 30 minutes on Stage 5 - retroactive). On this stage every [spoiler]wave is randomised[/spoiler] 
[*][spoiler]Lucky Draw added after completion of Bonus Stage - Spend excess gold here for a chance of a prize. There is a pity mechanic so you will never go too long without a win![/spoiler]
[*]Cursed difficulty unlocked after [spoiler]killing Bonus Stage 1 Boss and with 60 or above upgrades. [/spoiler] 
[*]When on Cursed difficulty [spoiler]a Genie appears after a certain amount of level ups and will grant very powerful boons, or tricky curses (if you're unlucky).[/spoiler] 
[*]Several remixed Enemies, Bosses & Elites added (many will only appear on the new difficulty)
[*][spoiler]G-Upgrades added after killing the Bonus Stage Boss. These new perma-upgrades enable far far higher level, "broken" builds by upgrading the boons granted by the Genie (and also lowering his curses).[/spoiler]
[*]1 Regular hero unlocked for defeating Bonus Stage 1 boss
[*]4 powerful new Bonus heroes unlocked through the [spoiler]Lucky Draw[/spoiler]
[*]4 new unique weapons that are exclusive to the new bonus heroes. Unlike regular weapons these start at level 8 because they are weapons that scale over time. The more you level up the more powerful they get! And they get very powerful, competing with ultimate weapons in terms of sheer damage.
[*]All 25 Regular heroes can now unlock an [spoiler] even more powerful Star version in the Lucky Draw. Star versions of the heroes enhance their key passives and/or stats. [/spoiler] 
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Completely reworked level up choices and the RNG factor
[*] As long as the weapon/item pool allows, rerolls should always show new choices
[*] An Ultimate weapon or item combo now displays on the LV up choice menu when unlocked (retroactive)
[*] Late Game Auto-levelling can now be enabled in the options menu. This means all choices during the infinite stat phase of level-ups will be automatically chosen at random and the level up screen not shown. The stat increases will still show above the hero
[*] Chests will now be picked up from a slightly further distance
[*] New animations for Thunderbolt attacks
[*] New animations and icon for Ice Spike attacks
[*] New Coin icons and sprite in game
[*]Paladin now shows when passive has healed him
[*]Wave number is now displayed on HUD
[*]Damage number size shrunk slightly
[*]Damage numbers tweaked to help with performance impact
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Level up choices are no longer fixed Weapon/Weapon/Item instead all choices are random
[*]Infinite stats now only become available upon level up after the first two pools have been exhausted
[*]Infinite stats now display a level number
[*]Healing and gold removed from LV up choices
[*]Lost XP pick-up now drops quicker once threshold has been hit
[*]Unlocking Hard mode no longer requires stage completion on normal, instead unlocks for all stages after 40 or above upgrade unlocks 
[*]New players now start the game with +300 gold
[*]Subtle Text Cues added for some secret bosses
[*]Enemy dogs fire attack changed to red hue for easier legibility
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]

[*] Windwaker's Fairy heal amount increased
[*] Warlock's Resurrection now increases his max HP upon reviving after every death (very powerful buff!)
[*] Archmage casts his random Ultimates slightly less frequently (Star version unchanged)
[*] Magnet max pick-up range doubled
[*] Ultimate Ward - petal rate adds cooldown scaling (this is a buff!)
[*] Some Ultimate cooldowns slightly increased to balance out the new boons available on Cursed difficulty
[*] Ultimate Banana slightly decreased explosion damage, still insanely powerful!
[*] Bosses damage adjusted depending on difficulty and player power
[*] Some elites buffed on harder difficulties
[*] Stage 3's Final Boss Bat attack collision reduced
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Thorn ward visual glitch
[*] Jelly fish move speed bug
[*] Thundermine DPS rate slightly lowered (was ticking too many times)
[*] Numerous other boring bug fixes
[/list]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
Some achievements have been removed with this update. As previously mentioned, Steam limits games to 100 achievements until your game meets a certain sales threshold, so no further achievements could be added without removing some existing ones first. More were removed than new ones added to allow some room for future additions (assuming the game doesn't meet the threshold).

[b]Removed:[/b]
[list]
[*] 20 upgrades
[*] 30 upgrades
[*] 50 upgrades
[*] 60 upgrades
[*] 500 kills
[*] 2000 kills
[*] 4000 kills
[*] 6000 kills
[*] 8000 kills
[*] Stage 1, Wave 5
[*] Stage 1, Wave 15
[*] Stage 1, Wave 25
[/list]
[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reach level 250 with any character in a single run
[*] Kill 20,000 enemies in a single run
[*] Kill the Bonus Stage 1 boss on any difficulty
[*] Survive 30 minutes of any stage on Cursed difficulty
[*] Kill any final boss on Cursed difficulty
[*] Unlock any bonus character
[*] Use a certain bonus character to defeat the final boss of Stage 2
[*] Purchase 25 G-Upgrades
[/list]

[h2]Final note[/h2]

Despite reaching this major milestone, Swarmcade will not be leaving Steam's Early Access immediately. The game is in a good shape now and the content goals for 1.0 have been met. But even with a lot of testing behind the scenes, with such a big update there could always be some things that could crop up that may need addressing before hitting that big Steam launch button. With all that said, it should be officially released sooner rather than later!

notes.title: Update #17 - Robotron 2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995291/d79ddf80eaf05c693d3702f6200ed201d88e5adf.png[/img]

The seventeenth update for Swarmcade is now live, and it brings two new characters to unlock, a new Ultimate and new achievements! Alongside the usual Balance, QOL, tweaks, and bug fixes.

 [h2]1.0 Coming soon![/h2]

This update should mark the final one before version 1.0. This major update has been worked on in the background for the past few months. 1.0 adds the final chunk of content before leaving early access - some cool new additions are still to come even if you have unlocked everything/achievement until now. Patch ETA is before the end of July (Unless something goes wrong at the last minute, but hopefully not!) 

[h2]Highlights[/h2]

[h3]NEW Robot Hero[/h3]

The Robot starts with the Thundermine weapon. His passive ability triggers the magnet effect every ~15 seconds (dependent on your cooldown) without the need for the magnet power-up. If you do grab the magnet master power up as well, he will gain more magnet time making it possible to max it out for the wave (perhaps with no downtime depending on your build). Great for a lazy build and those who want to make sure they get every XP drop as fast as possible.

[h3]NEW Explorer Hero[/h3]

The Explorer starts with the Line Bomb weapon, and a unique passive ability to find bonus chests on the map. This means the Explorer has the potential to max out his weapon and item loadout much faster than other characters, and on top of that, with more chests comes more gold, which is useful if you are getting low (and plenty of gold will be required to unlock everything in 1.0!)

notes.title: Update #16 - Mages, Monks & Bananas!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995291/c5ec185b9eb7f7529d1728f35cd21cb4fe71403b.png[/img]

The sixteenth update for Swarmcade is now live, and it brings two new characters to unlock, a new weapon, new Ultimate and new achievements! Alongside the usual Balance, QOL, tweaks, and bug fixes. 

[h2]Highlights[/h2]

[h3]NEW Archmage Hero[/h3]

The Archmage is a pure glass canon - he has immense power, but at the cost of very low HP. He starts with the Meteor weapon, but his passive ability allows him to randomly summon Ultimates of the elemental magic variety, e.g. Fire, Ice, Lightning. Yes, right from the start of the stage without levelling anything up! And these stack with the regular Ultimate Fire, Ice and Lightning for even more power. 

[h3]NEW Monk Hero[/h3]

The Monk starts with the Cyclone weapon, and comes with a unique ability to summon a healing aura on the ground. If you are in vicinity of the aura, you will be healed. This aura refreshes every 5 seconds and heals for the duration (on a cooldown). If you do move you will summon a new one near you. To gain maximum benefit, it is best to stay stationary within the aura. A good defensive character whose healing scales high. 

[h3]NEW Thundermine[/h3]

The Thundermine is does exactly as the name suggests. A mine is dropped that unleashes bolts of lightning at any foes stupid enough to get in range. The damage arcs out like chain lightning, hitting multiple foes. A very strong defensive weapon, but it's best to stay near the mine.

[h2]Achievements Removal[/h2]

Some achievements have been removed with this update. This was not a choice but a necessity. The reason: Steam limits games to 100 achievements only until your game meets a certain sales threshold. Unfortunately, Swarmcade has not met that threshold, so no further achievements could be added without removing some existing ones first. So some of the less interesting/easier achievements are gone to make way for the new ones added in this update. See the patch notes for a complete list.

notes.title: Update #15 - Burn Baby Burn!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995291/551c111386e92ebdebab3dcece7a3a34e3a59f41.png[/img]

The fifteenth update for Swarmcade is now live, and it brings two new characters to unlock, a new Ultimate to discover, new weapon, and new achievements! Alongside the usual Balance, QOL, tweaks, and bug fixes. 

[h2]Highlights[/h2]

[h3]NEW Pyromancer Hero[/h3]

Alongside the firepit weapon, the Pyro has a unique trait of leaving a trail of fire behind her. This will harm any enemy that comes into contact with it. The damage scales as the hero levels up, so it will be effective into the late game. 

[h3]NEW Angel Hero[/h3]

The Angel starts with Azazel's Tears and has a unique passive ability to mirror the laser beam. That means, for instance, if the hero is facing right the mirror version will fire left at the same time. Essentially, you are covered in both directions, making the Angel the best to use with the laser beam.

[h3]NEW Line Bomb[/h3]

This weapon drops a bomb during player movement. When it explodes it leaves a vertical or horizontal blast depending on the player's direction at the time it was dropped. The distance of the blast line starts small, but will increase massively as it levels up, eventually covering the distance of the whole screen!

notes.title: Update #14 - The Missing Link
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995291/a1ab80175d2542efa9ebc9ca55b2dbdd3d7b0256.png[/img]

The fourteenth update for Swarmcade is now live, and it brings two new characters to unlock, a new Ultimate to discover, a sneaky new secret boss, new achievements! Alongside the usual Balance, QOL, tweaks, and bug fixes. 

[h3]Windwaker Hero[/h3]

Alongside the bananarang weapon, the Windwaker hero starts with a unique fairy summon. The fairy has a few functions. She will heal the player when in danger (at or under 40% HP), attack enemies (with scaling damage) and "special" moves that will be amusing to fans of a certain massive game series...

[h3]Ghost Hero[/h3]

The Ghost starts with the Nom Nom weapon and has a unique passive ability to inflict fear most regular enemies periodically throughout runs (bosses and elites are not affected). Affected enemies are visibly changed whilst they are under the fear status. The best thing about this is that Ghost can then run into scared enemies to kill them instantly (you will not take damage). You gain more XP when you do kill them this way as well. It's a very unique and fun character trait and changes the way you play the game. Instead of avoiding the enemy, for a brief period, you can go after them every time it happens.

notes.title: Update #9 - New Upgrades, Vendor & Secret Boss
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995291/04b5dbf49baa919dc101fd076325bfa0e2567336.png[/img]

The ninth update for Swarmcade is now live, and it brings some major new upgrades, a new on-stage vendor, another secret boss, QOL/tweaks, new achievements and bug fixes.

A lot of you who have been playing since the early access launch will have likely maxed the Upgrades and accumulated excess gold. Some of you have asked for more things to spend gold on, and this update is happy to oblige! Let's look over it in better detail.

[h3]New Upgrades[/h3]

There have been 5 permanent Upgrades added, all are all quite game changing. 

First up, we have the new HP Regen. Yes, now all characters can unlock passive regenerating health. This is a big change for the game and should make the difficultly easier across the board. This offers an alternative to some players feeling they always have to pick Healing Wind (though surviving through heart drops is still possible, and has also been updated).

Note cooldown does affect HP Regen, so Hourglass as well as the infinite cooldown stats can increase the rate even further. Healing Wind is still in the game and essentially doubles the rate of healing.

Second, the Damage upgrade stat has been increased from 5 to 10 offering a new total max damage boost of 35%. It should help take the edge off some of the tankier foes.

Third, Extra Life has new levels. Each rank does not grant a new revival chance, instead it increases how much life you get after you are revived. It's now possible to increase your revive amount to around 70% of your total life.

The fourth and fifth upgrade warrants its own section...

[h3]Meet the Vendor[/h3]

Once unlocked in Upgrades (though either item or weapon upgrade), a vendor will appear on each stage. If the player visits him, they will find that he will stock every single regular item and weapon in the game! He does not stock those the player already holds.

This provides a way to now guarantee you have a way to get the item/weapon you want when you get those moments when the RNG is being frustrating, or you are out of rerolls. 

Buying from the vendor does come with a cost though. He doesn't trade in gold, instead a far deadlier currency: he wants your life! Not all of it, just a drop. His costs start high, but can be lowered through his upgrades. But the choice is yours. You don't have to take him up on his offer right away/or at all. He'll be happy to wait.

The vendor upgrades are split into two. One upgrade unlocks items, and the other weapons. Given how powerful he is, his upgrades are designed for a player at the late/endgame. 

(It is recommended to turn retro voices on to hear some dialogue from the vendor.)

[h3]Other changes[/h3]

As a result of passive healing being added to the game and increases to other upgrades, several items have had a balance tweak. Full details in patch notes follow.

[h3]v0.7.5 Patch notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*]NEW Upgrades added:
- Damage increased to 10 ranks (from 5)
- Extra life increased to 5 ranks (from 1)
- HP Regen added with 5 ranks
- Item Vendor added with 3 ranks
- Weapon Vendor added with 3 ranks
[*]NEW Secret boss added (can be fought on all stages)
[*]Balance: Heart drops now heal an increasing percentage of max health
[*]Balance: Healing Wind max level changed to 1HP/2s from 1HP/1.5s
[*]Balance: Nimble Nectar dodge chance changed to 10>20>25>30>40>50%
[*]Balance: Stage 3 bats are slightly faster to allow for faster kills during boss
[*]Balance: Ghosts and clown faces do slightly more damage on Stage 3 hard mode
[*]Tweak: Added an end wave if stages go on too long
[*]QOL: Several Upgrades descriptions changed for clarity/the new ranks
[*]QOL: Added patch version and notice to title screen (this is just for early access duration to make it easier to identify which version and highlight the biggest update for players)
[*]Bug fix: Fixed some more crash instances, most commonly caused by late game boss/chest spawns
[*]Bug fix: Rare instance of Final Bosses not spawning
[*]Bug fix: secret boss 3 sprite error
[*]NEW - 3 Achievements  [requirements]
- Purchase anything from the vendor
- Fight a super secret boss (any stage)
- Purchase 82 perma upgrades in total (this does not require maxing all upgrades)
[/list]
